:::{#sol-best-step-length}

```{r}
#| label: best-step-length-r
#| echo: false
bsl_eigs_ps <- c(1, 9)
bsl_s_star_ps <- 2 / sum(bsl_eigs_ps)
```

$\matr{S}$ is diagonal, so its [eigenvalues](linear-algebra.qmd#def-eigenvalue) are its
[diagonal entries](linear-algebra.qmd#def-main-diagonal) $1$ and $9$.
Then

$$
\steplen^* = \frac{2}{1 + 9} = `{r} bsl_s_star_ps`.
$$

:::
